roadmap.title: Chapter 1: Moving Pictures
roadmap.description: Play Chapter 1 once, gathering every collectible before you start the Ink Machine.

roadmap.title: Chapter 2: The Old Song
roadmap.description: Play Chapter 2 fully, including the Recording Room puzzle setup and the Bendy chase.

roadmap.title: Chapter 3: Rise and Fall on the Demon path
roadmap.description: Play Chapter 3 choosing the Demon path without dying during Alice Angel's tasks, then clear the chapter's collectibles.

roadmap.title: Chapter 4: Colossal Wonders
roadmap.description: Play Chapter 4, finishing the Haunted House side tasks, the Bertrum fight, and the plunger boss fight.

roadmap.title: Chapter 5: The Last Reel
roadmap.description: Play Chapter 5 through the harbor battle, the pipe puzzle and the ending.

roadmap.title: Chapter 3 again on the Angel path
roadmap.description: Replay Chapter 3 on the Angel path for the second ending and the remaining audio logs.

roadmap.title: Post-game and completion unlocks
roadmap.description: Visit the Archives from Chapter Select; the four completion achievements then unlock on their own.

roadmap.title: Ink Demon's Eve event
roadmap.description: Between October 23 and October 31, load Chapter 3 and walk to Heavenly Toys.

achievements.summary: Collect the six items that repair the Ink Machine in Chapter 1 and place them on their pedestals.

steps.text: Find the six @item{Ink Machine} parts in @loc{Chapter 1} and set each one on its pedestal.

achievements.summary: Fall through the floor after starting the Ink Machine in Chapter 1.

steps.text: Place all six parts so the @item{Ink Machine} starts.
Go back to the balcony where the machine was raised.
After the scare, run for the exit until the floor gives way.

achievements.description: Turn on the radio in Chapter One.
achievements.summary: Turn on the hidden radio in Chapter 1.

steps.text: Enter the small office in the hallway between the @loc{DREAMS COME TRUE} message and the @item{Ink Machine} balcony. It is the room with light under the door and the vinyl record.
steps.note: You can reach it while you collect the six machine parts.

steps.text: Turn on the radio.

achievements.summary: Walk through the hidden poster to find theMeatly in Chapter 1.

steps.text: Start the @item{Ink Machine}.
Return to the room where @npc{Boris} lay strapped to the operating table, where the wrench was.
Walk through the @loc{SHEEP SONGS!} Bendy poster on his right to reach theMeatly.

achievements.summary: Solve the musical puzzle in Chapter 2.

steps.text: Open Wally's closet with his keys and play the audio log inside to learn the instrument order.
Play the instruments in the order the audio log gives.
steps.note: The order is different every run.

achievements.description: Get all the Bendys on stage.
achievements.summary: Place all nine Bendy cutouts on the stage in the Chapter 2 Recording Room before solving the musical puzzle.

guide.context: A new cutout appears after each projector use, and only the upstairs booth can see them.

steps.text: In the @loc{Recording Room}, use the projector 9 times before you solve the puzzle.
From the upstairs booth, confirm 9 Bendy cutouts stand on the stage: 5 in front and 4 behind.
Solve the musical puzzle. The achievement unlocks when it is solved.

achievements.description: Turn on the radio in Chapter Two.
achievements.summary: Turn on the hidden radio in Chapter 2.

steps.text: Find the radio inside @npc{Sammy Lawrence}'s office and turn it on.

achievements.description: Collect all the Bacon Soup in Chapter Two.
achievements.summary: Collect all 31 cans of Bacon Soup in Chapter 2.

guide.context: The game does not count cans for you, so keep your own tally.

steps.text: Collect 23 cans before you open the shutter door at the start.
Collect 6 cans while you drain the lower level.
Collect the last 2 cans: one before the chase and one after it.

achievements.summary: Survive the chase by Bendy in Chapter 2.

steps.text: Escape your captor. A searcher appears and Bendy chases you.
Keep running until the chase ends.

achievements.summary: Walk through the hidden poster to find theMeatly in Chapter 2.

steps.text: Turn the pump control lever.
On the way back, enter the first room on your left in the hallway with the pipe organ.
Walk through the poster in that room.

achievements.summary: Play the pipe organ in Chapter 2 five times.

steps.text: Go down the hall to the left of the @loc{Recording Room} sign and enter the first door on your right.
Interact with the pipe organ 5 times.

achievements.description: Collected all the Bacon Soup in Chapter One.
achievements.summary: Collect all 21 cans of Bacon Soup in Chapter 1.

guide.context: The game does not count cans for you, so keep your own tally. Leaving the chapter before you finish resets its can progress.

steps.text: Collect 19 cans while you explore freely, before you start the @item{Ink Machine}.
Collect the last 2 cans after you fall through the floor.

collectibles.name: Audio log 1
collectibles.method: Turn on the toy machine, move the shelves aside, and play the log on the desk.

collectibles.name: Audio log 2 (Demon path only)
collectibles.method: Play it on the Demon path.

collectibles.name: Audio log 3 (Angel path only)
collectibles.method: Play it on the Angel path.

collectibles.name: Audio log 4
collectibles.location: Side hallway by the two-lever door

collectibles.name: Audio log 8

collectibles.name: Audio log 9

achievements.summary: Play the audio log in the sunken room on Level P in Chapter 3.

guide.context: The audio log in the sunken room also counts as the tenth audio log of Chapter 3.

steps.text: Get the Tommy Gun, or use the axe from the boarded-up room on @loc{Level 9}.
steps.note: The axe appears after the Butcher Gang attack.

steps.text: In the back right corner of @loc{Level 14}, break the boards and turn the valve.
steps.note: Stand with the elevator facing forward.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Level P} and enter the door next to the @loc{I DON'T WANT TO WORK HERE ANYMORE} message.
Follow the corridor down the stairs that used to be flooded.
Play the audio log at the bottom.

achievements.summary: Find all three of Alice Angel's gears in Chapter 3.

guide.context: This is Alice Angel's first task.

steps.text: Take the three gears from the boxes in the room with the Bendy dolls.

achievements.summary: Solve all the valve panel puzzles on Level P in Chapter 3.

guide.context: This is Alice Angel's third task.

steps.text: On @loc{Level P}, solve the valve panel puzzles to get 3 valve cores.

guide.context: This is Alice Angel's fourth task.

steps.text: Take the axe Alice Angel gives you after the third task.
On @loc{Level K}, destroy all 15 Bendy cutouts. Leave the one behind the elevator for last.
steps.note: Go back to the foyer first, then break the cutouts.

steps.text: Bendy appears when the last cutout breaks. Hide in the nearby outhouse.

achievements.summary: Survive the Butcher Gang's attack on Level 9 in Chapter 3.

steps.text: After the cutout task, go back to @loc{Level 9} and wait for the Butcher Gang to attack.
Jump onto the barrels under the stairs near the elevator and attack from there.
steps.note: Enemies cannot hit you on the barrels.

achievements.summary: Kill the three Swollen Searchers on Level 11 in Chapter 3.

guide.context: This is Alice Angel's second task.

steps.text: On @loc{Level 11}, kill the 3 Swollen Searchers.
Pick up the glowing ink blob each one drops.
If @npc{Piper} is a problem, go down the stairwell one level and hide in the outhouse. He ignores you there and you recover health.

achievements.summary: Collect the fifth ink heart in the inky abyss on Level 14 in Chapter 3.

guide.context: This is Alice Angel's final task.

steps.text: In the inky abyss on @loc{Level 14}, collect 5 ink hearts. The achievement unlocks on the last one.
Keep the hearts until you are ready to leave the chapter.

achievements.description: Collected all Bacon Soup in Chapter Three.
achievements.summary: Collect all 42 cans of Bacon Soup in Chapter 3.

guide.context: The game does not count cans for you, so keep your own tally.

steps.text: Collect 4 cans in the starting safehouse. One appears in the bathroom after you open the exit.
Collect 4 cans outside the safehouse.
Collect 4 cans on the dark path.
Collect 2 cans on @loc{Level K}.
Collect 2 cans on @loc{Level 9}, in the rooms past the @loc{She's Quite a Gal!} sign.
Collect 2 cans on @loc{Level 11}, in the room where you first see the Projectionist.
Collect 5 cans on @loc{Level P}.
Collect 19 cans in the stairways.

achievements.summary: Play with 25 Bendy dolls in Chapter 3.

steps.text: After Boris gives you the gent pipe, enter the room with Bendy dolls on the shelves.
Interact with 25 dolls. A doll squeaks when it counts.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Projectionist on Level 14 in Chapter 3.

steps.text: Shoot him with the Tommy Gun from above when you first meet him.
steps.note: The axe also works, but you will probably die. He keeps his damage when you respawn.

steps.text: Keep attacking until he falls.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 3 on the Angel path.

achievements.summary: Finish Chapter 3 on the Demon path.

guide.context: It unlocks at the very end of the chapter. Do this path first because Blazing Metal needs it.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 3 on the Demon path.

steps.text: On the desk with the first audio log, interact with the toy ink blob in the bowl until it looks like the @item{Ink Machine}.
steps.note: It comes back later in the chapter, so check again then.

steps.text: Choose the @mechanic{Demon} path.
Do not die while you complete Alice Angel's tasks.

achievements.summary: Give Boris the Wolf a bone in Chapter 3.

steps.text: Make soup for @npc{Boris} and open the door.
Return to the room where you woke up and pick up the bone next to the box with the soup can.
Give the bone to Boris.
steps.note: The safehouse door locks after you leave that room, so grab anything you need first.

steps.text: Survive the Butcher Gang's attack on @loc{Level 9}.

Walk through the poster in the back right corner, near the mechanism you used for a valve core.

Pick up the valve he drops.

achievements.summary: Restore power to the Haunted House in Chapter 4.

guide.context: The two minigames, Bull's Eye Bonanza and Bottle Wallop, are part of these tasks.

achievements.summary: Defeat Bertrum in Chapter 4.

steps.text: Play the audio log in @loc{Attraction Storage} to start the fight.
Take the axe from the crate that held the log.
When Bertrum slams one arm down, circular joints glow. Destroy all four joints on each of his four arms.
Stay on the outside edge, which is safe, and take your time.

achievements.summary: Ring the bell on the strength game in Chapter 4.

steps.text: Next to the @loc{Research and Design} entrance, swing the hammer of the strength game.
Swing when the hammer is pulled all the way back to ring the bell.

achievements.description: Get a perfect score on Bull's Eye Bonanaza.
achievements.summary: Get a perfect score in the Bull's Eye Bonanza minigame in Chapter 4.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Bull's Eye Bonanza} while you power the Haunted House.
Hit every target without a miss.
steps.note: The targets are in the same places every time, so memorize them and retry.

achievements.description: Get a perfect score on Bottle Wallop.
achievements.summary: Get a perfect score in the Bottle Wallop minigame in Chapter 4.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Bottle Wallop} while you power the Haunted House.
Knock all 9 bottles completely off the stand with only 3 balls.
steps.note: Throw fastest when the ball is at its lowest. Aim at the bottom two bottles at nearly full speed.

achievements.description: Take a Photo at the Photo Cutout.
achievements.summary: Take a photo at the photo cutout in Chapter 4.

steps.text: In the upper area of @loc{Maintenance}, stand behind the photo cutout.
Aim the crosshair at the camera and wait for the flash.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter Four with the Plunger.
achievements.summary: Finish Chapter 4 by defeating the boss with plungers.

steps.text: After you open the @loc{Haunted House}, do not enter. Go back to upper @loc{Maintenance}, open the trunk by the switch, and take the dial.
Before the boss fight, swap the dial on the right side of the machine for this one and set it to make plungers.
Phase 1: dodge Boris's charges until he grabs his chest and an ink blob appears. Make a plunger, sidestep a charge, and hit him.
Phase 2: take the new blob and make a plunger. Each plunger breaks after one hit. Keep moving while he slams from above, and hit him when he is on the ground.
Phase 3: make your last plunger. Dodge the three carts he throws. Getting hit by one kills you instantly.
When he weakens, land the final hit.

achievements.summary: Ride in a seat of Bertrum's machine in Chapter 4.

steps.text: Start the Bertrum fight and take the axe.
When Bertrum slams an arm and the weak points show, ignore them. Run to a seat and interact with it to climb in.

steps.text: Earn the five chapter achievements listed above. This one unlocks on its own with the last of them.

achievements.summary: Turn on all five hidden radios in the game.

achievements.description: Collect all the Bacon Soup in the Game.
achievements.summary: Collect all the Bacon Soup in all five chapters.

guide.context: Bacon Soup achievements: A Taste of Home, Canadian Bacon, Bring Home the Bacon, Just Like Mom Used To Make, and No Need for a Spoon.

steps.text: Earn the five chapter achievements listed above. This one unlocks on its own with the last of them.

achievements.summary: Complete the main story and watch the epilogue.

achievements.summary: Let Alice and Tom kill more than 15 enemies before the Chapter 5 swarm battle ends.

guide.context: You can earn this, Shadows and Suffering, and Aggression in the same battle if you are quick.

steps.text: Stand on the oil drum on the left side.
Wait while your allies fight. The achievement unlocks when they reach 15 kills.

achievements.summary: Clear the endless enemy swarm after the Sammy fight in Chapter 5 by killing 25 enemies yourself.

steps.text: Defeat @npc{Sammy}. Stand on the oil drum by the @loc{THE CREATOR LIED TO US} message to stay out of his reach.
Kill 25 enemies with your own attacks and clear the current wave.
steps.note: Kills by your allies do not count.

achievements.summary: Solve the pipe puzzle and open the vault door in Chapter 5.

guide.context: Valued Employee needs this same puzzle solved without being seen by the Butcher Gang.

steps.text: Make the three pipe pieces in @loc{Administration} and place each one in the puzzle.
Open the vault door.

achievements.description: Say Hello to an Old Friend.
achievements.summary: Walk through the hidden poster to find theMeatly in Chapter 5.

steps.text: Solve the pipe puzzle and enter the vault first. Without that the poster does not work.
Face Joey Drew's office and walk down the hallway on your left.
Enter the room on the right and walk through the poster on the left wall.

achievements.summary: Stand on the Henry Stein exhibit spot in the Archives chapter.

steps.text: Load a save slot where you finished the game, open @mechanic{Chapter Select}, and choose @loc{Chapter ?: The Archives}.
Turn right and stand on the spot for the Henry Stein exhibit.

achievements.summary: Find theMeatly in all five chapters.

guide.context: TheMeatly achievements: The Creator, Man Behind the Curtain, Tea Time, Barbecued, and A Sweet Discovery.

steps.text: Earn the five chapter achievements listed above. This one unlocks on its own with the last of them.

achievements.summary: Finish the Chapter 5 pipe puzzle without being seen by the Butcher Gang.

steps.text: Back up your save. At the time clock, save, quit to the menu, and continue.
steps.note: This resets the patrols. It works only in your first playthrough because Chapter Select cannot save.

steps.text: Wait at the @loc{Administration} entrance for @npc{Piper} to walk by. Follow him until he turns a left corner, then enter the room on the right.
Wait in the far corner by the desk until @npc{Striker} passes, then keep walking down the corridor.
After the long hallway turn right and slip past Piper to the ink pool. Take the ink blob.
Go back to the room and wait for @npc{Fisher} to pass. Then return to the entrance and throw the blob into the pipe spawner.
Take the pipe piece, hide from Bendy in the outhouse, then place the piece.
Reload your save at the time clock and repeat for the other two pieces. The achievement unlocks when the puzzle is done.

achievements.summary: End the Chapter 5 swarm battle within 2 minutes 30 seconds without dying.

steps.text: Back up your save, then start the swarm battle after the Sammy fight.
Kill 25 enemies yourself and clear the wave within 2:30. Target Searchers first because they die fastest.

achievements.description: Visit Heavenly Toys during Ink Demon's Eve
achievements.summary: Visit Heavenly Toys during the Ink Demon's Eve event.

steps.text: Play between October 23 and October 31.
steps.note: The event runs on these dates every year.

steps.text: Start Chapter 3 and play the opening with Boris until you reach @loc{Heavenly Toys}. The achievement unlocks soon after.
